context_visible: Aerial view of a rural settlement adjacent to large, rectangular agricultural fields.
The fields are filled with dense, low-growing green vegetation arranged in distinct rows.
A paved road runs horizontally across the middle of the frame, separating the fields from the residential area.
The residential area on the left contains multi-story buildings with grey and red roofs, situated along a canal.
The lighting is bright and sunny, casting distinct shadows from the buildings and trees.
cross_view_relations: The local crop view is a high-magnification segment of the upper-left quadrant of the context image.
The canal and the specific cluster of buildings with grey tiled roofs in the crop view correspond exactly to the structures visible on the far left edge of the context image.
The spatial relationship between the water, the road, and the houses is consistent across both views.
perception.description: The images show a rural landscape with a canal-side village bordering extensive green agricultural fields.
